title: Fruity Fruits! Mayhem Platformer! ( work in progress ) 1500+ pieces of art!
author: couldgiveaflyingfck
selftext:
Fruity Fruits!

My Amiga inspired platform game, with inspiration from QWAK, Bubble Bobble, Rodland, Super Frog, Gods, Putty Squad, Fire and Ice, Magic Pockets, and many many others.

I am aiming for 50 levels, special levels every 4 levels and boss fights every 10th level .. so 5 bosses in total. The last boss, The Rotten King, King Durian is a really fun fight, already built and tested over many many hours. I've an advanced game player and it's still difficult for me!

Game is designed around low skill, medium and highly skilled players. Low end ( kids ) get timers that FUDGE the numbers in their favor and enemies that don't always do damage, etc. It's fun for them regardless.

Average players will have fun but will still fail every 2nd or 3rd attempt until they get better within the game. Skilled players are the players that can get through to the 3rd, 4th and 5th boss. 4th and 5th boss will really test skilled players.

Lots of combo's, and hidden not so obvious ways to score big points and unlock really crazy stuff.

Have a lot of great original music and sound efx.
